author: Nintendo of America
description:
Outbound is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch April 23, 2026. Play the free demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/outbound-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

In this cozy-vival open world game, build your own home on wheels and live sustainably off-grid. Craft workstations and power supplies, source energy from the sun, wind, or water, upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and explore a colorful world with up to 4 players.
